modules.title: 同一份代码怎样让内部用户看到新功能、其他人走旧路径

items.title: 部署与开放可以不是同一时刻
items.text: 代码可以已随版本部署，但开关只让内部人员、少量用户或满足条件的人进入新路径。团队先观察真实信号，再逐步扩大范围，而不必等到代码重新发布才开始控制。

items.title: 关闭开关是针对路径的快速止损
items.text: 新推荐功能异常时，关闭开关会让用户回到旧路径；随后仍要查看监控、修复根因并验证。开关本身不会修复数据问题，也不自动恢复整个版本。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 功能开关不是版本回滚。关闭开关通常只停用一条功能路径，其他同版改动仍在运行；回滚恢复的是整个版本或配置。它也不是永久删除功能代码，长期不用的开关应在确认后清理。

lessonPractice.title: 新推荐页已部署，但团队想先让内部员工试用，出现错误能立即让大家回旧页且不重新部署。最适合的是？

options.label: 给新推荐路径加功能开关，只对内部员工开启；异常时关闭开关
options.feedback: 对。开关能控制谁进入已部署的新路径，并快速停止这条路径。

options.label: 每次只想调整试用范围都回滚整个版本
options.feedback: 回滚影响整个版本，不能细致控制同一版本中谁看新功能。

options.label: 先把旧页代码永久删除，等出问题再恢复
options.feedback: 这会失去快速回到旧路径的能力，也不是渐进开放。

en.title: The new recommendation page is deployed, but the team wants only employees to try it first and everyone to return to the old page immediately on error without redeploying. What fits best?

options.label: Add a feature flag for the new path, enable it only for employees, and disable it on anomaly
options.feedback: Correct. A flag controls who enters an already-deployed new path and can stop that path quickly.

options.label: Roll back the entire version whenever the trial audience needs adjustment
options.feedback: Rollback affects a whole version and cannot finely control who sees one feature in it.

options.label: Permanently delete old-page code first, then restore it if there is a problem
options.feedback: That removes the ability to return quickly to the old path and is not gradual exposure.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请给新推荐页加功能开关：默认只对内部员工开启，其他用户继续走旧页。上线后监控新路径错误率；超过阈值就关闭开关，并确认所有用户已回到旧路径，不要因此回滚整个版本。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add a feature flag for the new recommendation page: enable it for employees only by default and keep other users on the old page. Monitor the new-path error rate after release; above threshold, disable the flag and confirm everyone returns to the old path without rolling back the entire version.

learning.assumes: You know a new feature does not have to open to every user at once.
learning.outcome: You can tell when to expose a feature gradually by user scope and what portion of impact disabling a flag can stop.

modules.title: How the same code shows a new feature to employees and the old path to others

items.title: Deployment and exposure can happen at different times
items.text: Code can already be deployed, while a flag sends only employees, a small group, or qualifying people to the new path. Observe real signals, then expand without waiting for another code release to control access.

items.title: Turning a flag off quickly stops one path
items.text: When new recommendations misbehave, turning off the flag returns people to the old path; monitoring, root-cause repair, and verification still follow. A flag does not repair data or restore a whole version.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A feature flag is not a version rollback. Disabling one normally stops only one feature path while other same-version changes keep running; rollback restores a whole prior version or configuration. It is also not permanent code deletion; retire unused flags after confirmation.

distinctions.label: Rollback
distinctions.text: A {c:feature-flag} controls which people enter a code path at runtime. A {c:rollback} restores a system, configuration, or version to a known-good state.

distinctions.label: Quality Gate
distinctions.text: A {c:feature-flag} controls access to code paths dynamically at runtime; a {c:quality-gate} enforces test-passing and linting thresholds before code is merged or released.
